criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`: a new test drains a plan of three groups sized 3, 1 and 2 with max_concurrency 1 and asserts the report's group sizes are exactly [3, 1, 2].
criteria.evidence: parallel::group_sizes_are_recorded_with_a_bound_of_one passed. It runs drain_concurrent with bound 1, which sets one_at_a_time=true in drain_with. The plan is a,b,c free; d needs a; e,f need d. The test asserts plan_group_sizes == [3,1,2] and unplanned == 0.

criteria.criterion: A new test drains the same plan with max_concurrency 2 (drain_concurrent) and asserts the same sizes [3, 1, 2]; run with `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria.evidence: parallel::group_sizes_are_recorded_with_a_bound_of_two passed. It uses the same plan with bound 2 and asserts sizes [3,1,2], unplanned 0, and that all 6 jobs landed.

criteria.criterion: A new test has a queued item with no plan entry and asserts the report counts it in a separate unplanned field (1) and that no group of size 1 is added for it.
criteria.evidence: parallel::an_item_without_a_plan_entry_is_unplanned_and_not_a_group_of_one passed. The items are a, b, x, and only a and b are planned. The test asserts unplanned == 1 and plan_group_sizes == [2].

criteria.criterion: A new test renders the drain summary (display.rs) and asserts it contains a group-sizes line such as 'group sizes 3, 1, 2' plus the unplanned count; run with `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria.evidence: parallel::the_summary_prints_the_group_sizes_and_the_unplanned_count passed. It drains the 3,1,2 plan plus an unplanned item x with bound 2, renders display::drain(&report), and asserts the text contains 'group sizes 3, 1, 2; unplanned 1'.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md gains an entry that states only what the diff does (group sizes and unplanned count in the drain report and summary), with no claim about raising max_concurrency or editing athena.toml.
criteria.evidence: The new entry under [Unreleased] / Added names plan_group_sizes and unplanned in the drain report, covers both paths, and mentions the `group sizes` summary line. It says nothing about max_concurrency or athena.toml.

criteria.criterion: The group sizes are computed in the drain loop from the plan's groups (crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs) and the field has a doc comment explaining unplanned vs group of 1.
criteria.evidence: drain.rs:2949 computes `first_plan.groups.iter().map(Vec::len).collect()`. Lines 2950-2954 count the view.items that have no view.plan entry. The doc comment on `unplanned` (Report, ~line 1129) says these items are 'counted here and never as a group of one'.

findings.summary: One phrase in the design-doc status note is confusing.
findings.evidence: 'it is read from the plan, not from `plan.rs`, which is unchanged' reads oddly: the sizes do come from the Plan type defined in plan.rs. A clearer wording would be 'computed in drain.rs from the plan's groups; plan.rs is unchanged'. The file is on the deliverables list.

findings.summary: An item that is held back and has no plan entry is counted as unplanned.
findings.evidence: `unplanned` counts every view.item that has no view.plan entry. batches_for, by contrast, also skips items in plan.refused, such as paused items, which prepare does not read and so may have no entry. A held-back item without an entry is therefore counted as unplanned even though it is never worked alone. This matches the accepted reading ('not counted as unplanned unless they lack a plan entry'), so it is not a criterion failure, but the number can include held-back items.

summary: The change does what was asked. The drain Report gets two new fields: `plan_group_sizes`, the item count of each group in the plan the run started with, and `unplanned`, the number of queued items that have no plan entry. Both are filled in `drain_with`, the loop that both the one-at-a-time path and `drain_concurrent` use. `display::drain` prints a `plan        group sizes 3, 1, 2; unplanned N` line, and `athena drain` prints its summary through that function (main.rs:1319). I ran the four new tests and all pass: sizes [3,1,2] with bound 1 and with bound 2; an item without a plan entry gives unplanned=1 and sizes [2], not a group of 1; and the summary line appears. CI recorded fmt, clippy and the full test suite as passing. The CHANGELOG entry describes only what the diff does. The Report is not saved as a record, so record validation is not affected. The design-doc note is accurate but one phrase reads awkwardly. All seven criteria are met, and nothing I found is a blocker or major.
